messages:
lena_sec: Heads-up — scheduling a small canary base-image rebuild tomorrow 02:00 UTC to roll in the glibc CVE patch and do a minimal layer compaction. Need KMS signer access and a quick RBAC sanity check. Goal: test cosign signing, audit logs, and runtime smoke before full rollout. Who can own the keystore binding + audit sink check?

ash_infra: I can take the keystore/signing side. Will do a time-limited binding for the canary job. Need the exact key path and the SA to grant. Also can confirm logging sinks.

mike_runtime: I’ll own the runtime smoke and the pipeline patch. Which image tag / repo will we push the canary to?

lena_sec: Thanks. Key path is: projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/rebuild/cryptoKeys/cosign-prod. We’ll create a temporary key alias cosign-canary-2026-03 and bind it to service account sa-rebuild-canary@redwood-infra for the window. Required roles: roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeySigner + roles/cloudkms.viewer (minimal).

ash_infra: Plan to grant a 4h binding at T-15m and revoke after. Command I’ll run (dry-run on staging first):

```bash
gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding cosign-canary-2026-03 \\  
  --keyring=rebuild --location=global --member=\"serviceAccount:sa-rebuild-canary@redwood-infra\" \\  
  --role=\"roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeySigner\"
```

ash_infra: Revoke with the corresponding remove-iam-policy-binding after the window. I’ll also confirm the key is not set to automatic rotation for this alias.

mike_runtime: For verification I’ll use cosign verifying against KMS, example: 

```bash
cosign verify --key gcpkms://projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/rebuild/cryptoKeys/cosign-canary-2026-03 gcr.io/redwood/canary:canary-1718234567
```

sam_oncall: Also we need to confirm audit logs for KMS and Container Registry are flowing to the long-term sink. We need admin_activity + data_access for 90d and splunk forwarding. Who can check the sink config?

ash_infra: I’ll validate sinks. Quick check I’ll run now: 

```bash
gcloud logging sinks list --project=redwood-prod
```

ash_infra: Expected sink name: logs-to-splunk-prod. I’ll check that it includes KMS & GCR resource types and that the IAM service account for the sink has pubsub publisher perms.

lena_sec: RBAC gating item — the build pipeline should use an ephemeral role 'roles/redwood.rebuildCanary' instead of full image-manager. We want a short-lived binding or workload identity with 1h expiry. @mike_runtime can you patch GH workflow to use that role and ensure the action only has signing permission in canary context?

mike_runtime: Yes. Workflow change will use workload identity: 'projects/*/serviceAccounts/sa-gh-actions@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com' mapped to 'sa-rebuild-canary', and the pipeline will request a token scoped to rebuildCanary role. I’ll open a tiny PR and link it here.

rebuild-bot: deploy-bot: Canary build queued — repo=gcr.io/redwood/base-image, sha=abc123, tag=canary-1718234567

lena_sec: After the canary is pushed and signed, please run this checklist:
1) cosign verify returns OK
2) runtime smoke: boot to ready state <100ms and kv cache warm (script: ./scripts/smoke-canary.sh canary-1718234567)
3) confirm audit log entries for KMS 'CryptoKeyVersions' sign action and GCR push in Logging -> exported sink within 10m
4) sanity verify that no broad 'roles/storage.admin' or 'roles/container.admin' got accidentally granted to the pipeline SA

mike_runtime: I’ll run the smoke: `./scripts/smoke-canary.sh canary-1718234567` and post results. Smoke will run container startup, basic health endpoints, and a quick perf snapshot.

ash_infra: I’ll tail the logging sink and IAM changes during the window. If we see unexpected IAM grants, I’ll immediately remove them and ping @sam_oncall and the release channel.

sam_oncall: I’ll open #release-war-room for the window and monitor. If anything looks bad we’ll fallback: route traffic back to previous image and revoke the canary tag.

lena_sec: Rollback plan: revoke any temporary IAM binds, revert GH workflow to previous role binding, and re-tag old image as stable if necessary. Keep postrun notes short — include cosign logs and any audit ids.

mike_runtime: ack — PR: https://github.com/redwood/base-image/pull/412 (patching workflow). I’ll attach smoke logs when done.

ash_infra: staging dry-run finished, cosign verify OK against staging KMS alias. I’ll schedule production binding 01:45 UTC and revoke at 06:00 UTC.

rebuild-bot: deploy-bot: Canary build started: tag=canary-1718234567, status=building

lena_sec: Thanks everyone — please ping here if you see anything odd. I’ll draft a 1-paragraph post-run note in #eng-security after the window. :thumbsup:

mike_runtime: ack

sam_oncall: oncall will monitor — I’ll be present in the war-room.

rebuild-bot: deploy-bot: Canary build completed: pushed & signed — artifact=gcr.io/redwood/base-image:canary-1718234567, cosign-log=https://logs.redwood/cosign/1718234567

lena_sec: Great — leave this thread open until we confirm audit entries and smoke pass. If all green I’ll mark as 'canary-success' and schedule full rollout.
